summary: Visual regression testing completed for GitFable redesign iteration (callsine/obvious/vectara style). All pages tested: Landing, Discover, Dashboard, Leaderboard, History, Profile. Navbar/login modal, draw flow, filters, and mobile responsive layouts all working correctly. No functional regressions found from the visual redesign.

issues: Minor accessibility warning: Missing aria-describedby on login and PR dialogs (console warning only, not blocking). Already present in iteration_2 report.

passed_tests: Landing page: Hero section with floating cards, signal bento section, how-it-works, stats, bottom CTA, footer all render correctly
Navigation: All nav links (Discover, Dashboard, Leaderboard, History) present and functional with new styling
Login flow: Modal opens with proper styling, username input works, submit creates user and navigates to discover
User menu: Profile, Dashboard, Sign Out dropdown items present and styled correctly
Discover page: New signal grid (Draw Budget, Bookmark Slot, Focus Window) renders correctly
Discover: Language filters (10 languages) and difficulty filters (3 levels) toggle with new glow styling
Draw issue flow: Card shuffle animation, issue reveal with repo/title/language/difficulty/stars/labels
Bookmark flow: Bookmark button works, active bookmark shows with countdown timer, Submit PR/GitHub/Release buttons
Dashboard: Profile card, XP progress bar, streak indicator, stats grid, badges grid (10 badges), contribution heatmap, recent draws - all with new bento layout
Leaderboard: Tabs (Weekly/Monthly/All-Time) with new styling, podium top 3 with ambient glows, detailed table
History page: Stats cards (Total Draws, Bookmark Rate, Merge Rate), status filters with toggle styling, empty state message
Profile page: Header with avatar/level badge, stats grid, badges section, recent chapters - all styled consistently
Mobile responsive: Bottom navigation appears for logged-in users, layouts adapt properly to mobile viewport
No runtime errors from style refactor - only minor aria-describedby console warnings
action_items: OPTIONAL: Add aria-describedby to DialogContent in Navbar.js login dialog and Discover.js PR dialog to fix accessibility warnings
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full visual redesign verified. All pages and flows tested with new callsine/obvious/vectara-inspired styling. Neutral monochrome + sky accent palette applied consistently. Dense bento layouts, subtle ambient glows, and stagger reveal animations all working. Mock authentication and APIs remain mocked.
